title: Lennar Celebrates the Grand Opening of The Park at Amberwood
body_markdown:
*New Park Marks an Exciting Milestone for the Amberwood Community and the City of Selma*


SELMA, Calif.


, Sept. 9, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Lennar, one of the nation's leading homebuilders, today announced the opening of the new community park at Amberwood, a master-planned community of new single-family homes now selling in Selma, California. The community is invited to a ribbon-cutting celebration on Saturday, September 12 at 9 a.m. at the Amberwood Park, where guests can enjoy light refreshments, explore the community's newest outdoor amenity and learn more about the homeownership opportunities Amberwood will bring to the Selma area.


"This amenity is the heart of Amberwood, and introducing the park before our Grand Opening gives families the opportunity to experience the community the way they will actually live in it," said Jason Glasglow, Lennar Central Valley Division President. "This is the first park to open in Selma since the 1980s. Selma and Fresno-area homebuyers have long sought out new homes with real outdoor recreation space, and Amberwood delivers both."


Amberwood will feature 15 home designs across five exclusive Lennar collections, offering a range of floorplans designed to meet the needs of all homebuyers, from first-time buyers to multigenerational households. Homes range from 1,037 to 3,386 square feet with two to five bedrooms and two to three-and-a-half bathrooms. Amberwood will offer select plans available with a Next Gen® suite, Lennar's home-within-a-home design that provides a private living space with its own entrance to accommodate multigenerational families under one roof. Pricing starts in the mid $300,000s.


The newly completed park is Amberwood's first finished amenity, complete with picnic areas, a playground, and a basketball court, all ideal for outdoor recreation. Residents of Amberwood can also enjoy a fantastic location near central Selma, offering quick access to freeways, boutique shopping, popular area parks and excellent schools, in addition to a quick commute to Fresno.


Amberwood model homes are anticipated to open Fall 2026. Interested homebuyers can learn more about the Grand Opening and RSVP to the event[here](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4770523-1&h=2473281867&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lennar.com%2Fnew-homes%2Fcalifornia%2Ffresno-bakersfield%2Fevent%2Ffnolen_rsvp_amberwood&a=here) .


For more information on homes available at Amberwood, call (559) 778-8560 or visit the[community website](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4770523-1&h=4091414720&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lennar.com%2Fnew-homes%2Fcalifornia%2Ffresno-bakersfield%2Fselma%2Famberwood&a=community+website) .


**About Lennar Corporation**
Lennar Corporation, founded in 1954, is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making the American dream of homeownership attainable for more people. Since its founding, Lennar has built more than 1.5 million homes for buyers at every stage of life in communities across the country, from first-time and move-up buyers to active adults. Lennar's Financial Services segment provides mortgage financing, title and closing services primarily for buyers of Lennar's homes. Lenˣ drives Lennar's technology, innovation and strategic investments, shaping the future of homebuilding. For more information, visit[www.lennar.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4770523-1&h=338282794&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.lennar.com%2F&a=www.lennar.com) .


**About City of Selma** Selma is a rapidly growing community of nearly 25,000 residents and is located in the central San Joaquin Valley at the crossroads of State Routes 99 and 43. Its location has made it a regional hub for southeast Fresno County as well as neighboring Tulare and Kings Counties. Both new and long-time residents are discovering and rediscovering the joys of living in this delightful community. The spirit of "one community" brings together a very diverse population of creative and hardworking individuals at countless events offered through the city, the Chamber of Commerce, schools, places of worship, and other community groups. There is always something to do in Selma.
